name: Seohelpnow AI Blogger Tool
author: seohelpnow

sections.description:
Seohelpnow AI Blogger Tool is a powerful WordPress plugin designed to supercharge your content strategy for modern search. It combines automated AI blogging with cutting-edge SEO frameworks to help you rank in traditional search, answer engines, and generative AI overviews.

Whether you are a local business, an SEO agency, or a content creator, this plugin bridges the gap between your WordPress site and the LocalTrafficEngine platform (operated by Organic Traffic & Marketing Solutions) to deliver ready-to-publish, highly optimized content.

Why this plugin is essential for modern rankings:

  • AEO & GEO Ready (Answer/Generative Engine Optimization): Articles are crafted with natural language patterns, clear Q&A structures, and FAQ schema to win “People Also Ask” boxes and AI-generated overviews (like Google SGE and Bing Copilot).
  • E-E-A-T Signal Booster: The plugin enforces strict sanitization, validates JSON-LD structured data, and supports author credentials—directly contributing to Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, and Trustworthiness.
  • Local SEO Powerhouse: Supports location-focused articles, approved Google Maps embeds, YouTube videos, and localized FAQs to dominate local pack rankings.
  • Instant Technical SEO: Automatically generates /llms.txt and /ai-urls.txt files to help AI crawlers (like those used by OpenAI, Anthropic, and other LLMs) understand and index your site structure.
  • Search Engine Submission: Manages IndexNow verification keys to instantly notify Bing and other participating search engines of your new content (note: indexing is not guaranteed, but it drastically speeds up discovery).

Included Features

  • AI Content Generation & Blogging – Automatically receive and publish formatted, research-backed articles directly from the connected service. No more writer’s block or manual formatting.
  • AEO & AIO Optimization – Content is pre-formatted with JSON-LD, FAQs, and clear intent-based headers to maximize visibility in voice search, answer boxes, and AI-driven search results.
  • Local SEO & GEO Integration – Publish location-specific articles with embedded Google Maps, YouTube embeds, and structured local business data to attract nearby customers.
  • EEAT & Trust Signals – Safe sanitization removes spammy scripts while preserving valid schema markup, helping Google’s algorithms recognize your site as a trustworthy authority.
  • LLMs.txt & AI URL Generator – Instantly creates /llms.txt and /ai-urls.txt files from your public WordPress content, allowing Large Language Models to efficiently crawl and reference your site.
  • IndexNow & Bing Workflow – Securely manages the verification key required for the IndexNow protocol, enabling near-instant pinging to Bing and other participating search engines.
  • Authenticated REST Publishing – Secure, rate-limited API endpoints ensure only authorized services can publish content to your site.
  • Media Handling – Automatically downloads and assigns featured images from provided URLs, complete with type and size validation.
  • One-Click SaaS Connection – Simple dashboard to connect to the LocalTrafficEngine platform, with a built-in health test to verify your setup before publishing.
  • Privacy & Transparency – Includes suggested wording for your WordPress Privacy Policy Guide and clear information about the external services involved.

How It Works

  1. Activate the plugin – /ai-urls.txt and /llms.txt are live immediately.
  2. Visit Seohelpnow AI → About Service to understand the data flow.
  3. Go to SaaS Connection, paste your connection key from the Seohelpnow service, and run the health test.
  4. Start receiving optimized, ranking-ready blog posts directly into your WordPress dashboard!

Organic Traffic & Marketing Solutions uses smart data, practical SEO and AEO strategies, and creative marketing to help businesses improve online discovery and attract relevant audiences. The plugin does not guarantee traffic, rankings, citations, or indexing.

External Services

This plugin can connect to the LocalTrafficEngine platform operated by Organic Traffic & Marketing Solutions. Local /ai-urls.txt and /llms.txt generation does not require a connection.

Site connection

The plugin does not contact LocalTrafficEngine until an administrator submits a connection key or uses a connected feature.

During connection, the plugin sends:

  • The administrator-provided connection key.
  • The WordPress site URL and home URL.
  • The REST publishing endpoint URL.
  • The installed plugin version.

Connection endpoint:

https://localtrafficengine.com/sa/api/connect_plugin.php

The service returns a publish token. It is stored in the WordPress database and authenticates later publishing and IndexNow requests.

AI and local SEO publishing

After connection, the service may send:

  • Article title and formatted HTML content.
  • Requested publication status.
  • JSON-LD structured data.
  • An optional featured-image URL.
  • The authentication token.

Publishing endpoint:

/wp-json/localtrafficengine/v1/receive-blog

When an image URL is supplied, the WordPress server contacts that third-party host. The host may receive the server IP address and standard HTTP request metadata.

IndexNow and Bing workflow

The service may send an IndexNow verification key to:

/wp-json/localtrafficengine/v1/upload-key

The request must include the stored publish token. The plugin writes or rotates the key only when WordPress has non-interactive direct filesystem access. The external service handles URL-submission activity. Search engines independently decide whether and when to crawl or index a URL.

Service information

  • Service provider: Organic Traffic & Marketing Solutions
  • Seohelpnow website: https://seohelpnow.com/
  • LocalTrafficEngine platform: https://localtrafficengine.com/
  • Terms of Service: https://localtrafficengine.com/sa/terms.php
  • Privacy Policy: https://localtrafficengine.com/sa/privacy.php
  • Support and privacy contact: antonio@seohelpnow.com

The About Service page also links to optional external trial and SEO-audit pages. No payment is collected by this plugin. The REST namespace localtrafficengine/v1 is retained for compatibility with existing connected campaigns.

Privacy

When related features are used, the plugin stores:

  • Connection status and publishing authentication token.
  • Plugin version and welcome-notice preference.
  • The managed IndexNow key name.
  • Temporary authentication rate-limit records.
  • JSON-LD metadata associated with service-created posts.

Service-delivered articles are stored as WordPress posts. Downloaded images are stored in the media library. Posts and media remain after disconnection or uninstall unless an administrator removes them.

Data handled by the connected platform is governed by:

  • Privacy Policy: https://localtrafficengine.com/sa/privacy.php
  • Terms of Service: https://localtrafficengine.com/sa/terms.php

The plugin adds suggested disclosure wording to Settings → Privacy → Policy Guide. Site owners should review and adapt it. Privacy questions may be sent to antonio@seohelpnow.com.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the seohelpnow-ai-blogger-tool folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate it through the Plugins screen.
  3. Visit Seohelpnow AI in the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Review About Service and connect only when ready to use remote publishing.
sections.faq:
Is this only an LLMs.txt plugin?

No. It also supports authenticated AI blog publishing, local SEO article workflows, AI URL generation, JSON-LD, approved embeds, optional images, and IndexNow key management.

How does the AI Blogger feature improve content creation and rankings for AEO, AIO, E‑E‑A‑T, and local SEO?

The AI Blogger delivers ready‑to‑publish articles that are optimized for search intent and structured for modern search engines. Here’s how it helps:

  • AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) – Articles include clear Q&A sections, FAQs, and JSON‑LD that increase the chances of appearing in “People Also Ask” boxes and voice search results.
  • AIO (AI Optimization) – Content is written with natural language patterns that AI‑based search models (like Google’s SGE) prefer, improving visibility in AI‑generated overviews.
  • E‑E‑A‑T – The plugin enforces strict sanitization (no spammy scripts), stores valid structured data, and supports author credentials, helping establish topical authority.
  • Local SEO – You can receive location‑targeted articles with embedded Google Maps, YouTube videos, and localized FAQs, which are proven to boost local pack rankings.

By automating the content ingestion and formatting process, you can publish more high‑quality articles in less time, keeping your site fresh – a key ranking factor. The service behind the plugin (LocalTrafficEngine) provides the editorial research and topical insights, so you don’t have to start from scratch.

Which features work without a service account?

/ai-urls.txt, /llms.txt, the local dashboard, public-file routes, and feature-test tools. Remote article delivery and service-managed IndexNow requests require a connection.

Are arbitrary scripts or iframe hosts allowed?

No. Executable scripts are removed. Valid JSON-LD is stored separately. Iframes are limited to approved HTTPS YouTube and Google Maps embed URLs.

Does IndexNow guarantee Bing indexing?

No. The plugin manages a verification key for the connected workflow. Search engines decide whether and when to crawl or index a URL.

What happens when I disconnect?

The publish token is removed and future authenticated service requests are disabled. Existing posts, media, /ai-urls.txt, and /llms.txt remain.

What happens on uninstall?

Plugin options, rate-limit transients, the managed key file when accessible, and plugin-created JSON-LD metadata are removed. Published posts and media are retained.

How do I get support?

Email antonio@seohelpnow.com or visit https://seohelpnow.com/.

  • Completely overhauled features section to focus on user benefits and ranking improvements

1.0.21

  • Restored dashboard, connection, About/Services, and feature-test functionality while retaining security protections.
